_comment: Chrome and control strings. No economics here beyond the labels themselves.

app.title: Macro-Sim
app.subtitle: How a shock travels through the global economy
app.tagline: A teaching model, not a forecast.

policyRate.label: Policy rate
policyRate.help: You are the central bank. Move the rate and advance a quarter.

energySupplyGap.label: Energy supply shock
energySupplyGap.help: A disruption to physical supply. Positive numbers mean less energy and higher costs.

policyMode.label: Who sets the rate?

options.taylor: The central bank is on a rule

policyMode.help: On a rule, the bank reacts to expected inflation and growth by itself, and cannot move more than half a point per quarter.

panels.currents: What the economy is doing now
panels.pipeline: What is still in the pipeline
panels.map: Where in the system are we?

banners.shockQuarter: Markets have moved. The real economy has not responded yet.
banners.baseline: Everything is at its starting level. Set a rate or a supply shock, then advance a quarter.
banners.offScaleTarget: This target is beyond the model's limits, so the meter is showing the edge of the scale.
banners.ruleActive: You are no longer setting the rate. The rule is.

explanations.target: Where this would settle if today's drivers never moved again and every delay had finished. The distance between the two is the lag.
explanations.zeroContribution: This channel exists but contributed nothing this quarter, because it reads an earlier quarter.
explanations.expectationsLead: Markets price what they expect, not what has been published. That is why shares can move on a day when no figure has changed.
explanations.notSimulated: The lesson covers this layer, but the model does not compute it. Talk about it instead.

footer.disclaimer: Teaching magnitudes, chosen to make transmission visible over six to eight quarters. They are not estimates and this is not a forecast.
footer.outOfScope: Deliberately left out: fiscal policy, employment, separate countries, property, gold, a yield curve, and random shocks.
